mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) exceeding 0.3 percentage points in 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS < 380000) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), reduced liquidity and higher discount rates produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low CPIAUCSL growth (CPIAUCSL < 212.0) indicates low inflationary pressure, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 212.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS < 138000) exceeding 0.5% in 1 month signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 11600) indicate economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and GDPC1 < 11600.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 115.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when INDPRO > 115.0.
